title: Observable

inlines.v: OBSERV'ABLE, adjective s as z. [See Observe.] 1. That may be observed or noticed. 2. Worthy of observation or of particular notice; remarkable. I took a just account of every observable circumstance of the earth, stone, metal or other matter.
